description: This Java class implements a builder for creating responses and events for a live command that modifies features within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a fluent API for constructing command responses, success events, and error responses related to modifying features on IoT entities.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A builder class for constructing command responses and events related to modifying features within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable factory class for generating different types of command responses, including success and error responses.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable factory class for generating event instances indicating creation or modification of features.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new builder instance for the specified command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Constructs a command response using the provided factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Constructs an event (such as feature created or modified) using the provided factory function.
